compossed-message.message: Ink cartridges missing:

. Cartridges listed above seem to be missing, are not detected, or are incorrectly installed. If ink cartridges have been installed, check that the plastic tape covering the ink nozzles has been removed. Alternatively, remove the cartridge and re-insert it securely.

. The cartridges listed above appear to be missing or damaged. HP recommends that you replace any missing cartridges as soon as possible to avoid print quality issues and possible extra usage and/or damage to the print system. Please leave the printer powered on until all cartridges are installed to allow servicing to protect the print system.
Cartridge Problem:
. Cartridges listed above are damaged or have failed. Remove them and replace with new cartridges.
Incompatible Cartridges:

. Remove the cartridge and reinsert, making sure it is the correct slot.
Non-HP Cartridges Installed:

. HP cannot guarantee the quality or reliability of non-HP supplies. Printer service or repairs required as a result of using a non-HP supply will not be covered under warranty. If you believe you purchased Genuine HP cartridges, visit us at: www.hp.com/go/anticounterfeit for more information or to report fraud.
HP Protected Cartridge Installed:

. The cartridge(s) listed above can only be used in the printer that initially protected the cartridges using the HP Cartridge Protection feature, and must be replaced. When you are ready to remove your cartridge, you can find information on how to recycle it at: www.hp.com/recycle.

Although your printer can print in single cartridge mode (and your printer may have come with only one cartridge), you may wish to add the missing cartridge to enhance print performance and quality. Single cartridge mode printing may be slower and printed colors may vary from those you would see with all cartridges installed. If all cartridges are actually installed, check that the plastic tape covering the ink nozzles has been removed so that the printer can detect the cartridge. Alternatively, remove the cartridge and re-insert it securely.

If the sensor has failed, it can no longer sense when your cartridges are depleted. Printing with a depleted cartridge will cause air to enter the system which causes poor print quality. The printer will perform major cartridge servicing to try to recover from this situation. This servicing will shorten the life of the cartridge. You should only use this cartridge if you believe it to not be depleted. Replace the cartridge or press OK on device to use it.
